title: Astro Portal session event payload: resume
description: Marks the session as resumed after a pause event. An empty payload is valid on purpose, for the same one-tap reason as pause. Pairing a resume with the pause it ends is done by session order (recordedAt/receivedAt), not by an id in this payload. The resume sheet of the execution screen (« Rogner » or « Décaler » the rest of the night) also records its choice, `policy`, and the real pause duration it computed, `pauseDurationMinutes`, so that neither lives only in the interface's transient state (the schema had refused both). See session-events.md for what this type is for and what it deliberately is not.

policy.description: The resume sheet's two-card choice: `crop` (rogner: the targets keep their times, the rest of the night is shortened by the pause) or `shift` (décaler: the rest of the night slides by the pause).

pauseDurationMinutes.description: The real elapsed duration of the pause this resume ends, in minutes, as the sheet computed it.
